denominator_constraints: Videos, caption tracks, language-localized metadata entries and viewer geography events are different units and cannot be summed into unique people.
A video's metadata language is for title/description; defaultAudioLanguage refers to its default audio track, not all additional dubbed tracks.
Video subtitles, multiple audio tracks or localized thumbnails may include multiple languages for one video; counting them per language double-counts videos without a disjoint primary classification.
Country-level owner analytics represents the location of reporting activity, not the viewers' mother tongue or ethnicity; international language communities overlap.
Blank or absent metadata language must remain an explicit unknown class, not guessed from a country, creator name or video category.
A public search by language, locale or region is a selected/discoverability-biased sample, not an unbiased count of all active creators or YouTube audiences.
Caption metadata access is authorized and does not itself contain the transcript; it must not trigger unauthorized scraping or inference about private people.
Selected multilingual creator watch-time percentages are not global language adoption or causal translation lifts.

sampling_protocol.sort_canonical: one video per video_id, with primary metadata and audio language separate
sampling_protocol.country_comparison: separate authorized owner country rows by period from public video language metadata; no cross-tab of viewer languages without matched measurement
